_note: Hand-wound air coil (single-layer solenoid of enamelled copper wire). 2-terminal: a, b (the winding ends). Engine (bw-board air_coil): turns, radiusM, lengthM, wireMm give R (copper) and L (Wheeler); its current makes a field (fieldT at the centre, compassDeg for a compass on the axis compassCm away against earthT). A magnet dropped through it (control 'drop', or bumping params.drops) induces e = -dPhi/dt; metal at metalCm (metalKind nonferrous/ferrous, metalCoupling) shifts L.
